description: §6.8.4 rule 6: `reset-on=` on a `rule=` graph cell where a non-target state does not admit the reset target is E-RESET-ON-ENGINE-REFUSED.
rationale: §6.8.4 rule 6: "**Every state other than the target itself SHALL admit the target in its `rule=`** … A state that does not is **E-RESET-ON-ENGINE-REFUSED**, and the diagnostic SHALL name every refusing state and the target (\"`.Shipped` has `rule=.Delivered`; it does not admit the reset target `.Draft`\")." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "3b: `reset-on=` IS allowed on engine cells, checked against `rule=`" — "the new rec for engine reset, yes."
